subject: Executive intro + sponsor demo — availability and pre-brief asks
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: simon.lee@nexalytics.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 03 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive intro + sponsor demo — availability and pre-brief asks

Hi Simon —

Great to connect last week. Per our conversation, we’d like to set up a 45-minute exec intro + sponsor demo so your VP/CIO can see a short, targeted run of Redwood Inference against the ingestion patterns you mentioned. Goal: surface expected latency/cost tradeoffs for your prod-like dataset and confirm next steps for a pilot (SLA and Dedicated capacity discussion).

A few quick asks to make the session high value for everyone:
- Can you confirm who from your exec team (VP of Eng / CIO / CTO) is the primary sponsor and whether they can join?
- We’ll do a 10–12 minute tailored demo, 20–25 minute Q&A, 10 minute next-steps (MVP pilot scope).
- Please share any 2–3 specific evaluation questions we should explicitly answer (e.g., latency at 4k context, cost per 1k tokens, private deployment constraints).

Proposed 45-minute windows (PDT):
- Tue 8/5 10:30–11:15
- Wed 8/6 14:00–14:45
- Thu 8/7 09:00–09:45

I’ve attached a one-page agenda and a short exec brief checklist for your review. If none of these work, tell me a single day/time that does and I’ll route it. Ben (CC) will cover exec-level runtime questions; Marcus will run the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-8213
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nexalytics-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF), redwood-exec-brief-checklist.docx (DOCX)

From: Simon Lee <simon.lee@nexalytics.com>

Cc: priya.rao@nexalytics.com
Date: Mon, 04 Aug 2025 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro + sponsor demo — availability and pre-brief asks

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the write-up and options. Priya (our Dir. of Platform Ops) and I reviewed; the team would prefer a morning slot. Our VP of Engineering, Anika Rao, can join but only within the following windows (PT):
- Wed 8/6, 09:30–10:15
- Thu 8/7, 09:00–09:45 (best)

Two items for the demo: please prioritize 1) single-request latency at 4k / 8k contexts and 2) observable audit logs for private deployments. If you can show a short trace (end-to-end) that demonstrates our ability to map tokens to cost buckets, that will answer Anika’s top concern.

Also, Priya asked whether we can get a short list of personnel who should be on the call from your side (titles only). If helpful, we’re open to a quick 15-minute pre-brief with Priya before the exec demo.

Simon
VP Engineering, Nexalytics
simon.lee@nexalytics.com | +1 (415) 222-1991
